basic_details.job_title: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 80 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Manipur Staff Selection Commission (MSSC) has released Advertisement No. 02/2026 for recruitment to 80 Special Primary Teacher posts on a regular basis in the Education (S) Department, Government of Manipur. The recruitment is being conducted through sponsorship of the concerned employment exchanges of Manipur, and selection will be through a Computer Based Test (CBT). Online applications open on 31 July 2026 and close on 20 August 2026. This article covers the complete vacancy breakup, eligibility conditions, age limit, application fee, exam pattern, and the step-by-step online applicatio

application_fee.details: Payment is accepted only through online mode - UPI, net banking, or Visa/Master/Debit card. Applications submitted without the prescribed fee, or through any other mode, will be summarily rejected. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be held in reserve for any other examination. If payment details are not received from the bank, such applications will initially be treated as fictitious payment cases and rejected; a list of such applicants will be published on the MSSC website after the application closing date, and genuine cases will be revived on receipt of documentary proof, if otherwise eligible.

qualification.details: Essential: | 10+2 (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks from a recognized University/Board; or 10+2 (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks from a recognized University/Institution/Board, in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition Norms and Procedure) Regulations, 2002. D.Ed. in Special Education from an RCI-approved institute, with a valid RCI CRR number; or D.El.Ed. with a recognized qualification (Certificate/Diploma) through an RCI-approved institution for in-service/pre-service general teachers, equivalent to D.Ed. in Special Education, with a valid RCI CRR number. 6 months of training in teaching in the cross-disability area of inclusive education. If the proposed programme is not available, this requirement may be dropped, provided the candidate compulsorily undergoes this training as soon as it is conducted. Passed the Teacher Eligibility Test-1 (TET-1) conducted by the State Government or any other agency approved by NCTE.

selection_process: Selection is based on performance in the Computer Based Test (CBT). If the exam is held in more than one shift
marks will be normalized using the normalization formula adopted by MSSC. In case of candidates having the same score after normalization
ties are resolved using the following criteria
Total marks in the Computer Based Examination Date of birth
with older candidates placed higher in the list Alphabetical order of names (if required)

exam_pattern.details: All questions are of Class XII level. General Knowledge questions assess the candidate's knowledge of politics, history, geography, literature, sports, arts, culture, and special education. The exam is conducted through the Computer Based Test (CBT) mode; exam venues will be mentioned in the e-admit card. Questions are of MCQ type, carrying 1 mark each, with no negative marking for incorrect answers. Duration of the exam is 75 minutes. For PwD candidates using a scribe, 20 minutes' extra time per hour is provided, making the total duration 100 minutes.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online through the link on the Commission's website, and only candidates sponsored by the concerned Employment Exchange are allowed to apply.
Registration & Login: Register on the portal using parameters matching your Employment Exchange sponsorship credentials, then log in using your User ID and password.
Fill Application Details: Enter your profile parameters accurately - Name, Date of Birth, Category, Language, RCI CRR status, and Government Service NOC if applicable.
Upload Media & Sign Declaration: Upload your photo, scanned documents, and signature, and accept the mandatory qualification-validation declaration checkbox.
Application Fee Payment: Confirm your details and pay the fee via UPI, net banking, or card. Once payment is confirmed, the form is submitted and an acknowledgement receipt is generated.
important_instructions: The Commission reserves the right to amend this notification in parts or in whole. A candidate found furnishing incorrect information, suppressing information, violating instructions, or adopting unfair means such as impersonation or cheating is liable to be disqualified and/or debarred from writing this and subsequent examinations, as decided by the Commission. The schedule of the examination will be notified separately. Candidates are advised to visit the official MSSC website regularly for updates, and to use the technical support link in case of any difficulty submitting the form.

Candidates with a background in teaching and special education can also explore more Teacher Government Jobs and Special Education Jobs available across India. Those based in the Northeast can check the latest Manipur Government Jobs for more openings in the state. Candidates who have completed D.Ed./D.El.Ed. and TET can also browse Primary Teacher Jobs and TET Qualified Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Overview
Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application link will be disabled after 5:00 PM on 20 August 2026, and applications submitted through any mode other than online will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Within the 80 total posts, seats are also earmarked for Persons with Disabilities (PwD): 1 post each under (a) Blindness and low vision, (b) Deaf and hard of hearing, and (c) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, and muscular dystrophy. A PwD applicant must be a "person with benchmark disability," with not less than 40% of a specified disability, as certified by the certifying authority.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. The candidate must be able to speak Manipuri or any of the Tribal dialects of Manipur. The candidate must be a permanent resident of Manipur. A candidate whose parent, or any ancestor in their direct lineage, is a permanent resident of the State is also eligible, provided proper documentary proof is furnished.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Essential: 10+2 (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks from a recognized University/Board; or 10+2 (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks from a recognized University/Institution/Board, in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition Norms and Procedure) Regulations, 2002. D.Ed. in Special Education from an RCI-approved institute, with a valid RCI CRR number; or D.El.Ed. with a recognized qualification (Certificate/Diploma) through an RCI-approved institution for in-service/pre-service general teachers, equivalent to D.Ed. in Special Education, with a valid RCI CRR number. 6 months of training in teaching in the cross-disability area of inclusive education. If the proposed programme is not available, this requirement may be dropped, provided the candidate compulsorily undergoes this training as soon as it is conducted. Passed the Teacher Eligibility Test-1 (TET-1) conducted by the State Government or any other agency approved by NCTE.

content_sections.text: Registration & Login: Register on the portal using parameters matching your Employment Exchange sponsorship credentials, then log in using your User ID and password. Fill Application Details: Enter your profile parameters accurately - Name, Date of Birth, Category, Language, RCI CRR status, and Government Service NOC if applicable. Upload Media & Sign Declaration: Upload your photo, scanned documents, and signature, and accept the mandatory qualification-validation declaration checkbox. content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment
content_sections.text: Original documents proving educational qualification, experience, age, community/category, and disability (where applicable), to be produced when called for by the Commission. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned Department/Authority - mandatory for all candidates already in service, other than casual or muster-roll employees. Category certificate from the competent authority, to be furnished at the time of document verification if the candidate's claimed category is challenged. Failure to produce original documents when called for by the Commission will result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher e-Admission Certificate
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be issued an e-Admission Certificate, downloadable from the MSSC website; the schedule for downloading will be notified separately. No admission certificate will be issued from the MSSC office or sent by post, and no candidate will be admitted to the exam venue without it. Issuance of an e-Admission Certificate does not imply that a candidate's candidature has been finally cleared, or that the entries made by the candidate have been accepted as true and correct - the Commission's decision on eligibility for admission is final.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: All questions are of Class XII level. General Knowledge questions assess the candidate's knowledge of politics, history, geography, literature, sports, arts, culture, and special education. The exam is conducted through the Computer Based Test (CBT) mode; exam venues will be mentioned in the e-admit card. Questions are of MCQ type, carrying 1 mark each, with no negative marking for incorrect answers. Duration of the exam is 75 minutes. For PwD candidates using a scribe, 20 minutes' extra time per hour is provided, making the total duration 100 minutes.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Answer Key & Objection Process
content_sections.text: The provisional answer keys for the MCQ-based exam will be uploaded online soon after the test is conducted. Candidates get 3 days to submit objections to the provisional answer key, online only, along with a fee of Rs. 100 for each challenged question. All objections are referred to a team of experts constituted for the purpose, and their decision is final and binding on all stakeholders.

content_sections.heading: Manipur SSC Special Primary Teacher Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on performance in the Computer Based Test (CBT). If the exam is held in more than one shift, marks will be normalized using the normalization formula adopted by MSSC. In case of candidates having the same score after normalization, ties are resolved using the following criteria, in order: Total marks in the Computer Based Examination Date of birth, with older candidates placed higher in the list Alphabetical order of names (if required)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 80 vacancies for the post of Special Primary Teacher in the Education (S) Department, Government of Manipur.

faq.question: Q2. When can I apply online for MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window opens at 5:00 PM on 31 July 2026 and closes at 5:00 PM on 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only candidates already sponsored by their concerned Employment Exchange in Manipur are allowed to submit applications online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 400 for General and OBC candidates, and Rs. 200 for SC and ST candidates. PwD candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 38 years of age as on the date of notification, with relaxation available for SC/ST, OBC, and Government servant candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need 10+2 with at least 50% marks (or 45% under NCTE norms), along with a D.Ed. in Special Education (or equivalent D.El.Ed.) with a valid RCI CRR number, and must have passed TET-1.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) covering General Knowledge, Basic Mathematics, and English Language.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the MSSC Special Primary Teacher exam?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking for incorrect answers in this exam.

faq.question: Q9. What are the exam centres for MSSC Special Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exam will be conducted at Imphal, Churachandpur, and Senapati. Applicants choose their preferred centre at the time of submitting the online application.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for MSSC Special Primary Teacher?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level 6 under Group-C, Non-Gazetted services. An exact monthly salary figure is not specified in the notification.
